ordered_dithering.description: Uses a threshold matrix to disperse quantization error in a regular pattern.

floyd_steinberg.description: Diffuses error to neighboring pixels using specific weights (7/16, 3/16, 5/16, 1/16).

atkinson.description: A simplified error diffusion method that distributes error to fewer neighboring pixels.

blue_noise_dithering.description: Uses blue-noise patterns to produce visually pleasing, less repetitive dithering.

random_dithering.description: Uses random noise to turn pixels on or off based on input brightness.
